messages:
laura: Heads-up — did a walkthrough of the Console with PMs and support. The left menu feels overloaded; people keep looking in 'Models' for deploys and in 'Deployments' for model history. Proposing a small IA change: group by user-task (Build / Deploy / Operate / Observe) instead of resource type. Thoughts?

mike: +1 on task-oriented grouping. Curious how this plays with deep links — we need stable URLs so marketing docs and infra scripts don't break.

samir: Stability is primary for external links. We should define a URL contract: canonical paths for models, model-versions, deploys, experiments. E.g. /projects/:pid/models/:mid and /projects/:pid/deploys/:did. Also support short links for bookmarks.

jessica: From UX side, grouping by task is cleaner. But we must keep discoverability — breadcrumbs that show both group and resource could help: Projects > Build > Models > ResNet50. Also want keyboard nav: jump to sections with Cmd+K and arrow key cluster navigation.

andre: For model versions we need deep linking to a particular version + eval set. Proposal for routes (examples):
```
/projects/:pid/overview
/projects/:pid/models/:mid
/projects/:pid/models/:mid/versions/:vid?eval=:eid
/projects/:pid/deploys/:did?tab=logs
```
We should avoid embedding transient state in the path (like opened panels) unless we want permalinks. Use query params for UI state.

mike: On implementation: React Router v6 supports nested routes; we can map menu clusters to top-level routes and use Links for deep linking. Example: 
```
<Route path="/projects/:pid/models" element={<ModelsIndex/>}>
  <Route path=":mid" element={<ModelDetail/>}>
    <Route path="versions/:vid" element={<VersionDetail/>} />
  </Route>
</Route>
```
Need to ensure history stack behaves when opening a model detail from a list vs direct deep link.

laura: Accessibility nits: when a model page loads from a deep link, focus should go to the page heading and skiplinks must be predictable. Also ARIA labels for the cluster-level nav. Jessica, can we prototype focus flow?

jessica: Yup. We'll add a skip-to-content anchor and programmatic focus on H1 when route changes. Also propose visible breadcrumbs that are interactive (click to jump to Build/Deploy group).

andre: Two technical constraints: 1) Some customers pin old UI flows via bookmarks — we should support versioned routes like /v1/... for migration. 2) Short URLs used by support (copy-paste in tickets) must be resilient to IA changes. Could add a redirect layer: old paths -> new canonical.

samir: Good call. We should publish a migration doc and expose a stable "short link" API endpoint that returns current canonical path given an opaque id. Eg POST /shortlinks -> { target: "/projects/123/models/abc" }

mike: One more routing detail — modals vs pages. For quick actions (retrain, rollback) we often use a modal overlay. If someone shares a modal link, do we route to page + modal open? Two options: use query param ?modal=rollback or fragment #rollback. Query param preferred for semantic routing and server-side SSR fallback.

jessica: Query param is fine. UX note: opening modal via deep link must set focus to first interactive control and update URL so closing it restores previous URL (history).

laura: Analytics: track nav clusters clicks and deep link pageviews (nav_cluster, nav_target). Add event: {category: "nav", action: "click", label: "Build > Models"}. We need to maintain those event names across IA changes for cohort analysis.

andre: Edge case: when routing between private/private deployments and hosted models (different backends) we need to preserve region context in URL or cookie. Suggest a query param region=eu or /eu/ prefix.

mike: Implementation task breakdown:
- Routing: add canonical route map + redirect rules (eng)
- Breadcrumbs/focus: design & dev (jessica + mike)
- Shortlink API + migration doc (samir + backend)
- Accessibility QA + keyboard shortcuts (design + dev + accessibility team)

jessica: I'll sketch the updated menu clusters and breadcrumb states in Figma today and share link.

laura: Quick poll: who approves moving from resource-based menu -> task-based clusters? React with :thumbsup: to approve, :thinking_face: if you need changes.

nav-bot: deploy-status: no rollout scheduled.

mike: :thumbsup:
andre: :thumbsup: 
samir: :thinking_face: need migration doc date
jessica: :thumbsup:
laura: Thanks all — action owners: mike (routing PR), samir (shortlink/migration), jessica (Figma + focus flows). Will sync in design-review on Tue.
